note: References in the game to real things outside its own lore (Michael, 2026-10-18): one entry per thing, so every one is on a single page (the wiki's Real-world references) for whoever needs to see them all, a lawyer before launch among them. `thing` names what in the game carries it (an item id here; other kinds join as they come); `name` is its name in the game, kept equal to the item's by the validator; `work` is what it refers to; `how` says what the nod is, in a line; `since` and `from` say when it was made explicit and by whom.

references.name: Onion-head Hat
references.how: The hat's name, after a line of the song; Michael had been calling it his onion hat.
